what: Raised [budget] verifier_timeout_s from 1200 to 2400 in athena.toml by hand.
why: Two spec jobs in a row (20261018-120736-90w3, 20261018-133651-1ncn) lost their verdict when the verifier hit 1200 s: the full test suite now takes about 11 minutes and the verifier reruns it, leaving too little time to judge. A longer timeout does not weaken any check. Root fix to follow: let the verifier reuse the recorded check results instead of rerunning the suite.
